response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C/C++ (National Instruments), but lacks recent, deep C++ specialization required for this role. Their expertise is heavily skewed toward web/mobile development (Node.js, TypeScript, React) and Dlang, with no clear evidence of industrial automation, IoT, or cloud-platform development experience. Security practices (SDL) and industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) are not mentioned in their roles or projects.
strengths: Strong C/C++ foundation from National Instruments role
Extensive full-stack development experience with diverse technologies
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was 2015)
No demonstrated experience with industrial automation, IoT, or cloud platforms (Azure)
No mention of secure coding practices, SDL, or IEC 62443 standards in resume
